facts.fact: The Patapaye project, funded by the World Bank, IMF and EU, began a mobile money salary-payment test in March 2020 with about 250 employees, and authorities announced enrolment of civil servants intensified across at least 14 prefectures.

Business & Finance International reports that civil servants' salaries are domiciled at Ecobank Centrafrique and the Banque populaire maroco-centrafricaine, and that bank transfers exist alongside direct cash payment as salary payment modes.
